news.title: Bonds Slide as Inflation Fears Mount, Gold Breaks $4,400 – Asia Market Wrap
news.description: Government bonds in Asia Pacific followed Treasuries lower as oil’s four-day rally revived inflation concerns ahead of key US CPI data later this week. Gold advanced. Bonds dropped in Australia and New Zealand after US 10-year yields rose 6 bps on Monday to 4.71%. Treasury futures also fell, with no cash Treasury trading during Asian hours Tuesday due to a public holiday in Japan. The Dollar held its gains from the previous session. Gold rose for a third day, climbing above $4,400 an ounce
